after.topFix: Diagnose before you prescribe. Open with a tailored, route-level profit tree that includes an external/competition bucket, and treat 'price is the lever' as a hypothesis to test, not a conclusion to defend. Your early 'raise fares 12–15%' anchor survived even your own competitor inference until the interviewer forced the issue.
